overview.description: The AAM Sawgrass US Large Cap Quality Growth ETF (SAWG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund actively manages a narrow portfolio of US large-cap growth stocks, using quantitative and qualitative analysis for stock selection. The fund seeks risk-adjusted returns for long-term capital appreciation. SAWG was launched on Jul 30, 2024 and is issued by Advisors Asset Management.
